GSCPI.label: Global supply chain pressure (NY Fed)
GSCPI.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Global Supply Chain Pressure Index

ZORI_US.label: US asking rents (Zillow Observed Rent Index)
ZORI_US.source: Zillow Observed Rent Index (all homes, smoothed), United States

LD_CLI_DIFF.label: Leading-index diffusion: share of 17 economies rising over 6 months
LD_CLI_DIFF.source: OECD composite leading indices (USA, CAN, MEX, BRA, GBR, DEU, FRA, ITA, ESP, TUR, ZAF, CHN, JPN, KOR, IND, IDN, AUS); share above their level 6 months earlier

LD_RNM6.label: Global real narrow money, 6-month annualised growth (ex-China)
LD_RNM6.source: OECD key indicators (MANM) for USA, EA20, JPN, IND, GBR, CAN, BRA, KOR, AUS, less CPI inflation; GDP-weighted. China publishes no series to the OECD.

LD_RBM6.label: Global real broad money, 6-month annualised growth (ex-China)
LD_RBM6.source: OECD key indicators (MABM) for USA, EA20, JPN, GBR, CAN, KOR, AUS, less CPI inflation; GDP-weighted. China publishes no series to the OECD.

MY_FPX_B2C.label: Malaysia online payments (FPX) by consumers, 28-day total
MY_FPX_B2C.source: Bank Negara Malaysia via data.gov.my (trnsc_daily_fpx, B2C)

MY_FPX_B2B.label: Malaysia online payments (FPX) by businesses, 28-day total
MY_FPX_B2B.source: Bank Negara Malaysia via data.gov.my (trnsc_daily_fpx, B2B)

MY_ELEC_COM.label: Malaysia electricity use, business (commercial and industrial)

MY_EXP_EE.label: Malaysia machinery and transport equipment exports (SITC 7, incl. electronics)

LD_OI_PHI.label: Philadelphia Fed new orders minus inventories
LD_OI_PHI.source: Philadelphia Fed manufacturing survey via FRED (NOCDFSA066MSFRBPHI − IVCDFSA066MSFRBPHI)

LD_OI_AVG.label: Regional Fed new orders minus inventories (Philadelphia and New York)
LD_OI_AVG.source: Philadelphia and New York Fed manufacturing surveys via FRED; average of the two

LD_PP_AVG.label: Regional Fed prices paid (Philadelphia and New York)
LD_PP_AVG.source: Philadelphia and New York Fed manufacturing surveys via FRED; average of the two

LD_BASKET_LEAD.label: US cycle: Leading basket
LD_BASKET_LEAD.source: Average of 5 components' six-month change, each in standard deviations from its own past (FRED: PERMIT1, LD_OI_PHI, M2REAL, T10YFF, AWHMAN)

LD_BASKET_CYC.label: US cycle: Cyclical basket
LD_BASKET_CYC.source: Average of 5 components' six-month change, each in standard deviations from its own past (FRED: RES_JOBS, DMANEMP, HTRUCKS, HSN1F, NEWORDER)

LD_BASKET_AGG.label: US cycle: Aggregate basket
LD_BASKET_AGG.source: Average of 4 components' six-month change, each in standard deviations from its own past (FRED: PAYEMS, REALINC_XT, RETAIL_REAL, INDPRO)

LD_BASKET_LAG.label: US cycle: Lagging basket
LD_BASKET_LAG.source: Average of 2 components' six-month change, each in standard deviations from its own past (FRED: UNRATE, CORE_CPI)

LD_ASIA_PULSE.label: Asian trade pulse (early exporters)
LD_ASIA_PULSE.source: Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Japan and China exports, Taiwan export orders, Korean chip exports: 3-month average growth, each in standard deviations from its own past, averaged

LD_CN_FLOW.label: China new credit over 4 quarters, % of GDP (BIS)
LD_CN_FLOW.source: BIS credit to the private non-financial sector via FRED (CRDQCNAPABIS, QCNPAM770A)

LD_CN_IMPULSE.label: China credit impulse (BIS, quarterly)
LD_CN_IMPULSE.source: BIS via FRED: change over a year in the 4-quarter flow of new private credit, % of GDP. Arrives about a year late.
